title: Allowances launch
subject: Visigoth Bank, an invented retail bank
source: the PRD review, the dependency map and this conversation

records.title: Decide whose consent an under-18 allowance needs
records.context: Section 7.4 asks for recorded consent but does not say whose. The cardholder's consent and the minor's are different records with different retention rules. Risk will not sign off until this is named.

options.label: The cardholder only
options.consequence: Matches how authorized users are added today. No new step for families.

options.label: Cardholder and card user
options.consequence: Adds a consent screen for 16 and 17 year olds. About one more sprint for design and build.

options.label: Ask Legal first
options.consequence: Keeps the finding open. Sign-off waits about two weeks.

records.reason: It is the existing legal basis for authorized users, and Risk has said it would accept it with the record kept seven years.

records.title: Choose how fast a decline must be explained
records.context: The PRD promises a message within 10 seconds. In the spring interviews, five of eight teenagers said they would have walked away from the till by then. Platform says 3 seconds needs a push sent from the authorization path.

options.label: Within 3 seconds
options.consequence: Needs the push sent from the authorization path. Platform estimates one extra sprint.

options.label: Within 10 seconds, as written
options.consequence: No extra platform work. The explanation often arrives after the moment has passed.

options.label: 3 seconds as a target, 10 as the promise
options.consequence: Platform builds toward 3 but the customer promise stays at 10 until it is proven under load.

records.recommended: 3 seconds as a target, 10 as the promise
records.reason: It gets the experience Mara is asking for without making a customer promise Operations has not agreed to.

records.title: Decide what happens to charges that skip live approval
records.context: Transit taps and in-flight purchases arrive hours later and cannot be declined. They can be counted against the allowance, and an event can be raised when the allowance is passed.

options.label: Count them and alert the cardholder
options.consequence: The allowance can be exceeded. The cardholder is told the same day, once per month.

options.label: Count them silently
options.consequence: Simplest build. Parents discover the overspend on the statement.

options.label: Exclude them from the allowance
options.consequence: The allowance is never exceeded, but transit and in-flight spend is uncapped and invisible in it.

records.recommended: Count them and alert the cardholder
records.reason: It keeps the allowance honest and tells the parent promptly, which is what Risk asked for in RR-01.

records.source: Review finding MO-03, PRD sections 5.4 and 6.3
records.title: Pick which of the two low-balance alerts to keep at launch
records.context: The card user's low-allowance alert (5.4) and the cardholder's over-allowance alert (6.3) can arrive within minutes of each other.

options.label: Keep the cardholder alert (6.3)
options.consequence: 5.4 moves to a later release. One fewer notification type to build and test.

options.label: Keep the card user alert (5.4)
options.consequence: The teenager gets warning before a decline. The parent learns of overspend only from the app.

options.label: Keep both
options.consequence: Nothing is cut. Families may get two alerts about one event.

records.reason: The remaining amount is always visible to the card user, so their alert adds least.

records.title: Decide whether couples are in the first release
records.context: Section 2 says parents of teenagers first, couples later. Two requirements (R-11 and R-14) only matter for couples.
records.return_note: I need to know how many accounts have an adult authorized user before I can call this.

options.label: Teenagers only
options.consequence: R-11 and R-14 leave the first release.

options.label: Teenagers and couples
options.consequence: Two more requirements stay in. Consent rules for adults differ and need their own review.

records.reason: It matches section 2 and removes two requirements from the critical path.

records.source: Review finding F-08, PRD section 3.3 and FAQ
records.title: Settle when a changed allowance amount applies
records.context: Section 3.3 says right away. The FAQ says from the next cycle.
records.reason: 3.3 is the specification; the FAQ is older.
records.note: The FAQ is out of date.
